name: OpenNutriTracker
title: OpenNutriTracker: free MyFitnessPal alternative
install: Free on the App Store and Google Play
caption:
MyFitnessPal Premium charges $19.99/month to count your calories. OpenNutriTracker does it for free 🍎

✅ Scan a barcode, search, or quick-add any food
✅ Calories, carbs, fat and protein against your goal
✅ Vitamins and minerals, plus trends, water and weight
✅ No ads, no account, your diary stays on your phone

📱 iPhone · Android
ℹ️ Its food database comes from Open Food Facts, USDA and the German BLS, so it's smaller than MyFitnessPal's. MyFitnessPal Premium is $19.99/month, or $79.99/year on the annual plan
